basis.quote: Given a local or remote event, a non-controller, non-witness, non-delegator validator MUST first verify the event's controller signatures, witness signatures (if witnessed), and delegator anchoring seal (if delegated) before it can accept that event into its copy of that event's KEL.
basis.text: Interoperability with keripy 1.x, not conformance: the reading the suite's KERI decision procedure (docs/design.md, KERI) gives a KERI 1.0 body with keripy 1.x's field set, where keri-v1.0.1 would grade the same reading SHOULD, inferred under the quoted sentence. No specification defines the KERI 1.x field sets or the CESR 1.00 attachment codes. keripy 1.2.14 (commit bab95c16e949b61398129a3e41a8f68bad84c94f) is the cross-check (generators/keripy1x_check, generators/DISAGREEMENTS.md).

description: A delegator's inception, then a delegated inception naming it as delegator, with no delegating seal anywhere. A validator must not accept the delegated inception. Built on keripy 1.x's wire: KERI 1.0 bodies with keripy 1.x's field sets and CESR 1.00 attachments, mirroring KERI-0033 (KS-40) in keri-v1.0.1.
title: keripy 1.x: delegated inception with no anchor
